content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Springfield

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of education and project-management experience. Review PMI's documented requirements—secondary degree holders and bachelor's-degree holders face different experience thresholds. Verify your credentials meet PMI standards before enrolling, so you're ready to apply with confidence.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend sessions from your Springfield location on a schedule that fits your work. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world examples and exam-focused content over the required formal-education period.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, submit your formal application to PMI with proof of education and experience. Pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the application portal and documentation process to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your proctored exam at a testing center or approved remote location. Our instructors remain available to clarify difficult topics before you test.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll enter a standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, conference attendance, volunteer work, or self-directed learning. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to help you stay current and renew your credential on schedule.
